title: A Detention for the Prom
author: Felix Sterling
blurb: Jonah Sterling, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
